rules.statement: Money paid, but not due, can only be recovered back if it is made under a mistake or if an unequivocal protest or objection was lodged at the time of payment.
rules.supporting_quote: It may also be recovered if, at the time when the payment was made, an unequivocal protest or objection has been lodged. See the law as stated and supported by the South African authorities in Maasdorp, vol. HI., page 396.
